transcript: Never say these four things to yourself in the morning. The last one will quietly shape your entire day. But first, save this and send it to someone who needs it. One, I'm already tired. The day didn't even begin yet. Don't teach your body to feel weak before it moves. Two, I can't handle this. You've handled everything life gave you so far. Why would today be different? Three, nothing ever works for me. Be careful with this one. Your mind listens and it will start proving you right. Four, I'll just do the bare minimum today. This is how people slowly disconnect from their own potential. Not in one big moment, but in quiet daily surrender. Watch your words, because the way you speak to yourself becomes the way you live. Pause, breathe, begin again. But this time, speak differently. And if you feel like your mind has been a little too noisy lately, like you've been carrying thoughts you don't want anymore, I put something together for that. A simple 30-day reset to help you slow down, clear your mind, and feel like yourself again. If this spoke to you, follow me. You'll find it waiting for you in the link on my profile.
